items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Why, I like George Lois. Though he don't sound as good as he used to.

ctx.x: They started having Swedish jazz bands about that time?

Well they had bands earlier but it was more like dance bands. It wasn't that much jazz bands. In the middle of 44 as it said in that book. That was one of the first jazz bands. I never heard anything of that recording. The only first, the earliest recording I ever heard of jazz, Swedish jazz tradition is 49. Was that the Hapcats? No that was not the Hapcats. I was with the... I was with the... I can't remember that. It was called Gravo, right? Gravo, right? He had a girl sing in that tour. He sang like... I had a…
Do you know the girl's name who sang?
